lead.description: a repeatable play with listed outcomes, probabilities, and a numerical payoff

self_checks.title: Euro die
self_checks.prompt: A fair die pays 1 on an even face, 2 on a 1 or a 3, and -3 on a 5. What is the expected payoff?

self_checks.title: Face value
self_checks.prompt: A fair die is scored by the face that appears. What is the expected score, and what is the probability that the face is at most 4?
self_checks.answer: The expected score is 21/6 = 3.5. The probability is 4/6 = 2/3.

self_checks.title: Wheel
self_checks.prompt: A wheel pays 4 with probability 1/4, 0 with probability 1/2, and -2 with probability 1/4. What is the expected payoff?
self_checks.answer: The expectation is 1/2, so the game is not fair.

overview_sentence: A [game of chance](articles/game-of-chance.qmd) is a repeatable play whose outcomes and payoffs are fixed by stated rules.
